title: Add Top-Down Shooter game card to User View

requirements.text: In the User View (UserView.tsx), add a dark rounded card box above the Single Comment Generator section that contains: a 'Top-Down Shooter' title (styled in cyan/teal gradient text), instruction text ('Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Click to shoot. Survive as long as you can!'), and a 'Start Game' button. The card should use the existing dark glass-card style consistent with the app's dark space theme. Clicking 'Start Game' should launch the existing TopDownShooter canvas game inside or below the card.

quotes: make changes in user view only don't change any features just add game and make a box like in screenshot

acceptanceCriteria: User View displays a dark rounded card box with 'Top-Down Shooter' as the title in cyan/teal gradient text
The card shows instruction text: 'Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Click to shoot. Survive as long as you can!'
A 'Start Game' button is visible inside the card and launches the TopDownShooter game when clicked
The game card appears above the Single Comment Generator section
No other tabs (Upload, Live Checker, Admin) are modified
No existing features are broken or changed
The card styling matches the dark space theme with rounded corners consistent with the screenshot

constraints: Only modify the User View (UserView.tsx) — do not change Upload, Live Checker, or Admin tabs
Do not remove or alter any existing features in UserView
Use the existing TopDownShooter component (TopDownShooter.tsx) — do not rewrite it
Card styling must match the dark rounded glass-card aesthetic shown in the screenshot
nonGoals: Adding game history or retrieving past games
Changing any other view or tab
Redesigning the existing Single Comment Generator section
